WITH exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER 
    WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1 and DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A
)
, BUSC AS (
    SELECT B.FORACID, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
    WHERE A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '2023-01-27'--- AND B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP'
)
,BNKM AS (
    SELECT  A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE A.AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND A.PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27'--- AND B.IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP'
)
,BUSC_list AS (
SELECT 
    ---COUNT(*) ==
    A.FORACID
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL FROM BUSC GROUP BY FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) A 
    FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM BNKM GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance) B 
        ON A.FORACID = B.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE B.AccumulatedCurrentBalance IS NULL
    ---AND (A.FORACID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR A.FORACID IS NULL) AND (B.CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR A.FORACID IS NULL)
-----There are ACID without FORACID so NULL FORACIDA but has date and balance
)
,BNKM_list AS (
SELECT 
    ---COUNT(*) ==
    B.CustomerAccountId
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL FROM BUSC GROUP BY FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) A 
    FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM BNKM GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance) B 
        ON A.FORACID = B.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL IS NULL
    ---AND (A.FORACID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR A.FORACID IS NULL) AND (B.CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR A.FORACID IS NULL)
-----There are CustomerAccountId in BNKM but not in BUSC
)
SELECT SUM(ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL FROM BUSC GROUP BY FORACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) A
    WHERE FORACID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR FORACID IS NOT NULL --- 

SELECT SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance) FROM 
    (SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM BNKM GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance) A 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM BNKM_list)



SELECT SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance) FROM 
    (SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM BNKM GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance) A 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) OR CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM BUSC_list)
